scripts.build:sites: pnpm build:design-system && pnpm --filter @harnessa/marketing build && pnpm --filter @harnessa/cloud-portal build
scripts.deploy:marketing: pnpm build:marketing && wrangler pages deploy apps/marketing/dist --project-name=harnessa-site --branch=main
scripts.deploy:cloud-portal: pnpm build:cloud-portal && wrangler pages deploy apps/cloud-portal/build --project-name=harnessa-cloud --branch=main
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run mypy --follow-imports=silent apps/api/harnessa/contracts.py apps/api/harnessa/services apps/api/harnessa/domain apps/api/harnessa/adapters apps/api/harnessa/db/orchestration.py apps/api/harnessa/db/model_gateway.py apps/api/harnessa/db/models.py apps/api/harnessa/db/session.py apps/api/harnessa/api/task_routes.py apps/api/harnessa/api/model_routes.py apps/api/harnessa/healthcheck.py apps/api/harnessa/worker.py
scripts.lint:api: uv run ruff check apps/api tests scripts
scripts.test:api: COVERAGE_FILE=coverage/python/.coverage uv run coverage erase && COVERAGE_FILE=coverage/python/.coverage uv run pytest -n 4 -m 'not integration' --cov=harnessa --cov-report=
scripts.test:integration: HARNESSA_REQUIRE_INTEGRATION=1 COVERAGE_FILE=coverage/python/.coverage uv run pytest tests/integration -m integration --cov=harnessa --cov-append --cov-report=
scripts.test:coverage:python: COVERAGE_FILE=coverage/python/.coverage uv run coverage json --pretty-print -o coverage/python/coverage.json
scripts.test:web: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.mts --coverage && pnpm exec vitest run --config apps/cloud-portal/vitest.config.ts --coverage && pnpm --filter @harnessa/marketing build && uv run python scripts/check_marketing_build.py
scripts.test:coverage:check: uv run python scripts/check_project_coverage.py --python coverage/python/coverage.json --javascript coverage/javascript/coverage-final.json coverage/svelte/coverage-final.json --minimum 85
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:contracts && pnpm typecheck:design-system
scripts.test: pnpm test:api && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:coverage:python && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:coverage:check
